biography: Sohan Bapary is an AI-Legal Architect and Computational Law Researcher (LL.M.) specialising in cross-border digital sovereignty, algorithmic accountability, and automated compliance. He bridges the gap between international legal doctrine and systems architecture by engineering "policy-as-code." He is the creator of Vigilanci and IGRIS Core—platforms designed to align autonomous software workflows with international regulatory standards (GDPR, EU AI Act). He currently manages data protection operations at Datawallet while advancing academic research on autonomous agent liability.
